config.label: H: reward ratio: per_line 10 -> 50 and per_piece 5 -> 1. G's income is 89% per-piece and 7% per-line, and a line clear (+10) nets about the same as the two pieces of survival it costs (+10, minus ~2 of holes and height), so max-Q has no reason to prefer clearing. This makes a line worth 50 pieces of survival and survival worth little, so the only way to earn is to clear. Predicts fewer pieces and score but more lines per 100 pieces; if it only loses score and clears no more, the objective was never the binding constraint (everything else identical to G)

training.description: dqn 6000 episodes, seed 4, lr 0.001, batch 64, buffer 50,000, gamma 0.99, eps 1->0.05 over 20,000, target every 500, 256x256, cpu, [per_line=50, per_piece=1]
